item.title: Randy Orton: 15th World Title "Would Mean the World to Me"
item.description: Randy Orton discusses his chase for a record 15th world title on ESPN, trailing only Flair and Cena. The Viper enters his 10th Elimination Chamber Saturday in Chicago.

item.title: Randy Orton Wants to RKO the G.O.A.T. NFL QB
item.description: Randy Orton says Tom Brady is at the top of his RKO list after Brady called WWE "cute" on Logan Paul's podcast. Orton addressed the remarks on ESPN's Get Up.

item.title: Paul Heyman Explains Why He Calls Bron Breakker Every Day
item.description: Paul Heyman reveals he nearly quit wrestling after a dislocated shoulder, and explains why he calls Bron Breakker every single day during his recovery.

item.title: Paul Heyman's Vision: Building the Next WrestleMania Main Eventers
item.description: Paul Heyman reveals The Vision's long-game purpose — developing the next generation of WrestleMania headliners while planning all the way to Saudi Mania and beyond.

item.title: Bronson Reed Suffers Torn Bicep on Raw, Out Indefinitely
item.description: Bronson Reed has been diagnosed with a distal bicep tear and is out indefinitely, with WrestleMania 42 in serious doubt. All three Vision members are now injured.
